topic: Who we are: product-minded dev team
caption:
We build software that ships. 🚀

Gravity is a development team that designs, builds and launches:

▸ Web apps & websites
▸ iOS & Android apps
▸ Backends, APIs & cloud infrastructure
▸ Full products, from first sketch to launch

We don't just write code to a spec. We build our own products too, so we think like founders: what to build first, what to skip, and how to get to launch without burning the budget.

Over the coming weeks we'll share practical guides on building apps, plus a look inside the products we've built.

Have an idea you want to build? Send us a DM. 💬
